name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.77 / build 78 restores completed SMAPE and MAPE cards with Complete and View / edit. Reopening consistently enters the editor and preserves separate form drafts. Either medical-form notification opens all submitted forms in Medical History, with accurate clinic review statuses and explicit record viewing. Saved vital signs remain read-only. Existing form images, exports, booking, chat and section scrolling are retained. No backend or patient-data change is included. Existing development/test signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval. Install over a compatible existing app without uninstalling or clearing app data. Physical-phone installation, native on-device interaction and actual patient push delivery were not verified.
